verdicts.subject: Fixed diagonal square-zero preparations lying in E. Reference versus one unknown nonzero weighted rank-one perturbation.
verdicts.qualification: Q/R/C K3 minima 3/3/19. The real min(p,q)+1 requires p,q≥1 and a nondegenerate form, including the split (1,1) minimum 2. Complex d=2 needs 2. Real definite forms and complex dimension ≤1 have no rival. Full-middle null lifts outside E can reduce the K3 Q/R count to 2.

verdicts.subject: Arbitrary finite signed weighted sums on a prescribed totally null U, characteristic-zero field.
verdicts.qualification: N=binom(r+2,3) fixed trinion readings is sharp. This linear family is also pairwise recoverable with N readings. Additional restrictions on which null lifts in S are available need a new feasibility check.

independent_checker_deductions.statement: When ordinary null states may lie in all V and project to E, the actual Q/R K3 baseline count is 2. Explicit x_i=C+e_i+f_i.

Fixed diagonal trinion readings distinguishing all weighted rank-one tensor alternatives pairwise require exactly 20 over Q/R, even with all probes null in E. The same 20 lower bound holds over C; one prescribed rational null basis fails there.
